findings.claim: Windows corrected v1.5.1 candidate passed self-integrity, Start done/0, balanced/targeted ACTIVE with Adult coverage and stable representative HTTP 200 probes; cold XHamster variability is traced to one unreachable Cloudflare edge, not a failed DPI profile.
Gemini remains HTTP 403 in curl and real Chrome on the current public egress. Direct-only architecture cannot change that egress and therefore cannot truthfully promise a usable Gemini page.
Earlier Windows v1.5.1 Start failure was packaging integrity-pin drift. Source and contract regression now prevent declared Start-Direct pins from diverging from packaged runtime files.

Do not promote global Strong, CDN IP pinning, or system route hacks. Keep balanced/targeted default with host-specific strong overrides and maintained Adult catalog; publish only after one final exact-artifact rebuild/install/CI gate.

decision.claim: Do not promote 1.5.1 yet. Preserve v1.5.0. Highest gate is exact current-candidate installed acceptance; prefer Linux once source transfer/remote synchronization is available, otherwise perform bounded Windows Stop→install→Start/rollback acceptance only when necessary.

exactNextAction: Commit final candidate metadata/evidence, rebuild from that commit, exact-install Windows artifact, run live Start/site/rollback and protected CI, then merge/publish only if exact-head gates pass.
